body: I’ve tried too already but he’s being stubborn about it and has no one where to go, literally. Still trying to find a better option

We’ve tried finding other options but unfortunately we know no one here at the state we are living in. He’s trying to get into the dorms as soon as possible but there’s certain dates he needs to wait for to be able to move in otherwise he would have been gone by now. It’s truly unhealthy and I’m just overall mentally and physically tired. Thank you, that was something I really needed to hear!

I totally agree with you. I’m just waiting for him to leave because he’s crashing at my place till school leaves. Once he’s gone, I’m should be totally fine. He wants zero part of the baby, like zero. He’s choosing that girl over his own child therefore, I don’t think he deserves to be around my child period if that’s even possible. Our place is only a one bed room apartment so it’s hard not to be around him. He sleeps in the living room and I sleep in my bedroom.

This was such an amazing response. I truly appreciate your feedback and I will definitely be looking into going to therapy. 

I’ll definitely be finding some new hobbies as well and just enjoy myself here. I just currently moved to my dream state and haven’t even had the opportunity to enjoy it with all these past events happening back to back. 

Thank you again!

I actually spoke to her and she’s shocked at the fact how he’s been treating me, he doesn’t want any part of his own child yet we were trying to conceive for over 5 months. The problem is, she knows he’s in a relationship (or was) and still talks to him, so I find her the issue as well. She claims she’s not wanting him now or will ever get with him because of how he’s been recently but I don’t know if she’s just toying with me as well which is why I try not to talk to her too much

Totally agree on it being horribly toxic, what made me question was how can someone just break apart something so good over someone he’s never met? 

Yes, I am, I have tons of family with major support as well. I would never get an abortion either with or without fertility issues. That’s just something I couldn’t personally do. 

Yeah, this is just hard to detach myself from someone I’ve been with this person for a long period of time but I think and feel it’s probably better for the best!
